verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a text API reference (llms/api endpoint descriptions) and an OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json. Nothing documents an interactive explorer or runnable, try-it examples. A static reference and a machine-readable spec are adjacent building blocks, and the browser demo is a model playground, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
